settings.title: Moneybird Settings
settings.intro1: Configure your Moneybird API settings to enable integration with your Moneybird account.
settings.intro2: Please ensure you have the correct API token, administration ID and select the user you want to associate with you timetracking data.
settings.adminIdHelp: You can find your administration ID in the url of your Moneybird administration, e.g. https://moneybird.com/123456789.
settings.apiTokenHelp: You can create an API token in your Moneybird account settings under Settings > External applications. Leave all permissions checked except the "Bank" permission.
settings.userHelp: Select the user you want to associate with your timetracking data.

onboarding.welcomeText: Timebird is a Moneybird time tracking app.

onboarding.tokenHelp: You can create an API token in your Moneybird account settings under Settings > External applications. Leave all permissions checked except the "Bank" permission.
